organization_diagnosis: No direct row evidence; no missing-org diagnosis or manual SQL seed is justified. Public fixture creates workspace via an active-org gate. Missing publish root fails independently.
missing_user_session_scope: Failure is at the final Playwright template button after prior login/route/tab assertions; no evidence that initial session recovery caused this failure. Later final auth-error assertions were not reached.
unknowns: No database queries were permitted, so current organization rows and exact request-by-request organization callbacks were not directly inspected. However public workspace creation code requires EnsureInternalOrganization to return active before committing; missing publisher directory remains a sufficient independent blocker even with an active organization.

API middleware logs retain method/path/status but not the internal store-error category/body; no claim that one specific inaccessible-index or org branch was observed in a server stack trace. The configured absent root is directly verified and would necessarily fail openRoot.

Some retained error-context files are effectively empty after test cleanup. Their exact UI disappearance or cleanup timing is unknown; use the failure identity, source boundary and real GET503 rather than invent a visual cause.

The13 selected final cases include3 direct skill-catalogAPI503 errors,1 direct MCP filesystem fixture failure and9 blocked template/category/card UI cases. The latter are consistent with the verified catalogue failure but their full product journeys were not reached. A fresh initialized setup replay must verify the remedy.
